text:
alex: PM prewarm done for eu-west-1 and us-west-2. saw ~18% higher queue than expected after ramp, prewarm nodes drained in eu-west-1 due to spot evict. left drain tag on node k-az3.
maya: thx alex — metrics look ok overall, but latency tail spiked ~2s during drain. uploading trace: https://go/trace/abc123
maya: can we get a temporary quota bump for eu-west-1 +1 instance (g4dn.xlarge) to smooth the ramp?
ops-bot: @infra-ops created quota-request draft, linking ticket when ready.
derek: I can open the ticket, but need the exact AZ and instance type to request.
alex: eu-west-1a, used spot g4dn.xlarge; fallback planned to g5.xlarge on-demand.
olivia: canary rollout still on schedule; no perf regressions in the staging runs.
derek: pinging @sam for code review on the prewarm script change (made a small change to node selector). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/789
sam: will review in ~30m.
ci-bot: Deploy started: prewarm-config v2.1 -> env: staging (build 542)
alex: quick command i used to force-drain the node that evicted:
```
kubectl cordon node/k-az3
kubectl drain node/k-az3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
maya: note for next time: add --grace-period=120 and a prewarm-eviction-hook to avoid mid-token kills, saw a few OPENAI_TIMEOUTs in traces.
derek: blocker: quota increases with cloud provider typically take 2-4h. we should enable the fallback pool asap: set fallback_pool: "on-demand-eu" in fleet config so traffic shifts automatically.
alex: added fallback and pushed to ops-config branch, updated fleet config and canary flags.
olivia: ops-team — can someone confirm the quota ticket is created and assign it to @finance for budget sign-off?
maya: created ticket #4321 and assigned to infra-ops (left note about expected cost delta). link: https://issuetracker/4321
ops-bot: ticket 4321 created and tagged infra-ops, priority P2.
sam: reviewed the PR, left two tiny nits about logging verbosity. no functional blockers.
alex: thanks all — i'll monitor overnight and open a follow-up if the tail persists. :thumbsup:
